(39)༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid zla rgyal lugs kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (39)༄༅// thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid zla rgyal lugs kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so//

(40)༄༅// spyan gzigs zla rgyal skyi tsha dbu dkar ba// mya ngan med dpal rin 'od 'brug sgra gnur// rgyal sras rgya ma pa dang lo tsā ba// rgyal grags byang sems dkon rgyal sbas pa'i rje// 'jam mgon grol mchog chos sku lha dbang grags// kun snying phrin las rin chen rgya mtsho dpal// mtha' yas kun bzang tshe dbang nor bu'i sde// ngag dbang rnam rgyal kun bzang mthu stobs zhabs// nyi ma chos 'phel blo gsal bstan skyong dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mchog gsum skyabs mchi byang chub sems gnyis bskyed// cir snang lha dang stong nyid snying rje'i ngang*// mnyam rjes kun tu lam khyer rnal 'byor gyis// 'phags mchog go 'phang thob bar byin gyi rlobs/ zhes pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa sid+dhi ra stu// ༈ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid zla rgyal lugs kyi nyams len snying por dril ba zung 'jug gsang lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ// snying rje'i dbang phyug 'jig rten mgon// mi byed gus pas mchod byas nas// 'phags mchog zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi// thugs bcud zab don snying po 'dri/ 'di la gnyis/ mnyam bzhag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes thob kyi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs/ skyabs sems ci nus rgyud dang 'dres nges bya// spro na yan lag bdun gyi sgo nas tshogs bsags pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim mo// dang po ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ /stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du rang sems hrī dkar po las pad+ma 'dab brgyad gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba/ ze'u 'brur hri'aḥyig gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur ba las/ rang nyid (41)skad cig gis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/

phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ phyag g.yas 'og mas mu tig dkar po'i phreng ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing ri dwags kriṣ+ṇa swa ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas ri bo po tā la nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' dbang lha rigs lnga dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rang la thim rigs lngas dbang bskur bas/ dbang rtags su bla ma 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan/ ces yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi tshul gyis lha'i sku snang stong 'ja' tshon lta bur shar ba'i gsal snang la sems rtse gcig tu bzung mthar bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi dbus su hriḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ ces gsal btab la sngags phreng la yid gtad de klod pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla/ skabs su/ snying ga'i sngags phreng las thugs rje chen po'i sku dang 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs par bsams la bzlas pa'ang bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de'i ngang la chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs gzod ma nas zhi ba'i ye shes blo 'das gnyug ma'i dbyings su der 'dzin mi bya bar rang babs lhod kyis glod de mnyam par bzhag /gal te rnam rtog zhig thol gyis skyes na/ tha mal 'khrul ba'i dbang du mi btang bar sems kyis shis rig stong zung 'jug gi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ gdangs byams pa dang snying rje byang chub sems kyi rtsal sbyang*/ gsum pa ni/ thun las ldang ba na/

dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo ba dang smon lam zung du 'brel bas mtshams sbyar te/ gnyis pa rjes thob kyi (42)rnal 'byor ni/ zas za ba gos gyon pa/ stan la 'dug pa sogs kyi skabs thams cad lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas 'dod yon la zhen pa med par longs spyod/ nyal ba'i tshe snying ga'i hrīḥl sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ ldang ba na lha'i skur gsal bzhin ba'i ngang nas ldang ste rnal 'byor la 'jug /'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi rlung sems gnyis med kyi ngo bo snying ga'i hrīḥyig dbu ma'i las brgyud/ skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim bla ma bde ba can du gshegs par bsam la dbyings rig bsre/ bar do da lta nas nges thob kyi snang ba spyi dang bye brag thams cad bar dor dran pas kha bsgyur te/ snang grags rtog gsum 'phags pa'i gsang ba gsum du shes par byas te lam du 'khyer ba la bslab par bya'o// 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs 'phags rnams kyis// gang gi mkhyen brtser rab bsngags pa// 'jig rten mgon po dgyes pa'i lam// zla ba'i bzhed gzhung snying po'o// thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid spyan ras gzigs dngos byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi lugs srol gyi nyams len snying por dril ba'i le'u tshan no/// /
